summary: Liquidia Technologies, a wholly owned unit of Liquidia Corporation, and United Therapeutics executed an October 13, 2026 settlement ending all patent, trade secret and contract litigation, including matters relating to U.S. Patent Nos. 11,824,327, 11,357,782 and 10,989,494 and the North Carolina Business Court case. Liquidia keeps marketing YUTREPIA for PAH but must delete the PH-ILD indication, halt PH-ILD promotion, and pay UTC $175.0 million net within 30 business days plus $145.4 million in two installments by January 31 and April 30, 2027. Releases vest only on payment, dismissals with prejudice and FDA label approval. Watch label-approval timing and installment funding.
